missing_metadata: Per-response settings object absent; execution settings retained from stage config and lifecycle command.
provenance.measurement_scope: Mac/Metal raw-completion accuracy only; no Mac throughput or memory is substituted into GCP scoring.

policy: Grade the entire raw /completion output, including planning text and any literal thinking tags; do not apply chat final-answer-only extraction.

strict_pass requires a correct, unambiguous answer and all explicitly requested substantive calculations, explanations, comparisons and checks. A required check may use a genuinely distinct numerical method; it must actually verify the result rather than repeat the derivation or merely say confirmed.

core_answer_correct records the main requested result separately from faulty or omitted explanation/checks. An isolated correct number in a list or unresolved conflicting core answers does not suffice.
A uniquely correct option value with valid working may pass without a letter, flagged accordingly. An explicitly wrong option letter fails strict_pass even if its associated value is correct.
Clear self-corrections are accepted. Unresolved substantive mathematical/scientific contradictions and unsafe additional advice fail strict_pass.
Word-count, sentence-count and repetition deviations are separate from substantive correctness. A token cap alone does not fail a response whose complete correct answer is already present.

Prior semantic decisions are reused only when the complete answer SHA-256 exactly matches a previously reviewed original GCP answer. Every nonmatching response is read in full and manually adjudicated.
This is provisional assistant grading of an internal STEM battery, not an official ADTC grade, ARC accuracy, or composite competition score.

reuse_audit.note: Only semantic decisions transfer for identical full text; Mac source lines, hashes, runtime and completion metadata are independently retained. Original GCP results are not edited.

original_option_parser.meaning: Saved option-parser marks are diagnostic only, not the manual score.

review_status: all 100 adjudicated; selected new boundaries independently cross-reviewed

independent_review.result: Root independently rejected S10's conflation of plasma blood fluid with plasma cells. A separate reviewer read the complete S42 output and confirmed all experimental-design components. Five passing semantic answers from the original treatment are preserved, four by exact hash and S05 by full fresh read; S42 is a new independently reviewed pass.
independent_review.limitation: The second reviewer has not independently regraded all 100 Mac responses.
